payload.detail: RECHECKED 2026-09-25 on main 2c787a506: still no Passages Perth, Passages Peel or Youth Focus record in src/lib/services-canonical-data/ or source-acquisitions.json. The cloud session's network egress refuses every publisher host (wa.gov.au, mhc.wa.gov.au, aihw.gov.au, ruah.org.au, youthfocus.com.au, passages.org.au, healthdirect.gov.au and others all returned connect_rejected on 2026-09-25), and the sources skill forbids taking a publisher, date or contact detail from anywhere but the publisher's own page, so this cannot be done from a cloud session. TO UNBLOCK: run it from an unrestricted network, for example a Remote Control session on the owner's PC, or have the owner approve each page fetch. The claim that Passages Youth Engagement Hub and the two others 'now appear in the clinical sign-off queue' is false: no Passages record exists in src/lib/services-canonical-data/ or source-acquisitions.json, and c68c6ff41 says they were deliberately absent. PRIOR DETAIL: BLOCKER REMOVED 2026-09-18 (PR #2880, merged); THE DECISION IS STILL THE OWNER'S, which is why this row stays open. Both publishers the three WA services depend on are now registered in source-authority-registry.ts as named agencies: Department of Communities (WA) and City of Vincent. They are deliberately NOT the 'Government of Western Australia' catch-all an earlier block refused — a catch-all resolves every WA government document to one authority, whereas these two resolve only their own material. Both are catalogueIdentityOnly: true, so they are excluded from runtime retrieval classification and ranking is unchanged. WHAT IS LEFT IS THE OWNER DECISION THIS ROW ASKS FOR: registering a publisher admits no source. Passages Youth Engagement Hub and the two others still enter as unreviewed candidates at D band and cite nothing until signed off. They now appear in the clinical sign-off queue at /mockups/development/clinical-sign-off under Sources, which is where that decision can be worked.
